assertionResults.reason: The exact legacy type-name grep came back clean, but non-test frontend source still contains frontend-owned old naming in comments, local identifiers, and local strings after excluding allowed backend wire-format reads.

`part64/frontend/src/hooks/useAgentHandlers.ts:382-388` still creates the local identifier `const muse = payload.muse ...`, then reads `muse?.id` / `muse?.label`.
`part64/frontend/src/hooks/useAgentHandlers.ts:453-454` still uses the local hash seed string `|daimon|` in active overlay logic.
`part64/frontend/src/types/index.ts:186` still documents presence kinds with the comment `e.g., "muse", "logos", ...`.

frictions.description: Repo-shell validation required separating allowed backend wire-format residue from frontend-owned naming residue.
frictions.resolution: Only local identifiers/comments/strings and active user-visible copy were counted as failures; raw backend access patterns on the right-hand side were treated as allowed per mission notes.

summary: Repo-shell round 4 rechecked VAL-FS-003, VAL-UI-001, and VAL-UI-006 after the round-3 fixes. All three still fail: frontend-owned naming residue remains in non-test source, translucent backgrounds remain in PresenceCallDeck, and active visible copy still includes glass/transparent/observer-thread/braids/hologram wording. Read-only validators showed vitest still at the accepted 111 passing / 12 failing baseline, while eslint reported 0 errors and 94 warnings.
